name: Black Forest Ice Cream Cake
ingredients_raw: Ice Cream Ingredients (43%): Potable Water, Milk Solids, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Emulsifying Agents (INS 433, 471) & Stabilizing Agents (INS 401, 407, 412) and Flavour (Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla)} Veg. Cake Ingredients (41%): Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Edible Vegetable Oil (Refined Palm Kernel Oil), Raising Agents [INS 500(ii), 341(i), 341(ii)], Baking Powder, Emulsifiers & Stabilizers (INS 477, 415, 471), Iodized Salt, Food Colours (INS 150c, 150d) and Flavour {Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Chocolate)}, Chocolate Sauce (8%) {Potable Water, Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Stabilizing Agents (INS 407, 412, 466), Food Colour (INS 150d) and Flavour (Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Chocolate)} Topping (16%): Choco Covering (8%) [Cocoa Solids, Sugar, Emulsifier (INS 476) and Flavour {Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanillin)}], Whipped Cream (8%) [Potable Water, Sugar, Edible Fat (Hydrogenated Oil), Cocoa Solids, Sodium Caseinate, Emulsifiers (INS 475, 433, 435), Stabilizers (INS 464, 415), Salt, Acidity Regulator {INS 339 (ii)) and Flavour {Nature-Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla, Chocolate)}]
